sections.chapter_title: Resource isolation slave unit for address space protection (full version) (RISAF)
sections.text_helper: Section 7.5.3 "RISAF illegal access clear register (RISAF_IACR)" in chapter 7 (Resource isolation slave unit for address space protection (full version) (RISAF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 266.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Secure, privileged, trusted domain CID = 1, write access only.
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 IAEF: Illegal access error flag
Set this bit to clear IAEF in RISAF_IASR, allowing the capture of a new error information
from RIF in RISAF_IAESR and RISAF_IADDR registers.
Note: Clearing this bit does not clear RISAF_IADDR.
Bit 0 CAEF: Configuration access error flag
Set this bit to clear CAEF in RISAF_IASR.
